unit_of_detailed_opportunity: one RL decision x one legal move
scope_notes: Detailed legal-move opportunity telemetry is collected for RL decisions.
Opponent actions are retained in actions.csv but are not exploded into opportunity rows by default.
Generation-wide Pokemon catalog is a canonical base-species structural catalog, not a Random Battles legality list.
Form-level and benchmark-specific Pokemon ecology is measured from the frozen fixed pool.
Fixed-pool catalogs describe the frozen benchmark teams, not the full metagame.
semantic_corrections: Main move boosts are routed by move target: SELF-target boosts are self boosts, not target boosts.
Generation-wide Pokemon catalog contains canonical base species only, bounded by historical National Dex generation cutoffs.
Fixed-pool catalogs resolve duplicate manifest records by generation/pair/side with last-record-wins, matching evaluation semantics.
